messages:
maria.gupta: Hi team - first week q: I'm setting up CI for our feature tests that stream completions. Where should I keep the API key for CI and can I use a sandbox key for nightly runs?

.tom.brennan: hey maria, congrats! :tada: Short: never commit keys. For CI we use organization secrets (GH Actions secrets) or our internal credential broker. Sandbox keys are fine for quick dev checks but are rate/quotas constrained.

maria.gupta: got it. What happens if the sandbox throttles mid-test? We need deterministic CI behavior for nightly regression gates.

kai.huang: you have three pragmatic paths: 1) shorten tests so they fit sandbox quotas, 2) use a hosted key stored in GH secrets (but expect shared-bucket throttling), 3) request a short-lived scoped test token + temporary quota bump from DevEx. The last gives most deterministic behavior.

maria.gupta: how do I request the scoped token? any template?

devex-bot: To request test tokens or sandbox quota increases, open an internal support ticket at https://redwood-internal/support. Include: repo, workflow name, expected test concurrency, average tokens per run, and why deterministic runtime is required. Typical SLA 1-3 business days.

.tom.brennan: also, if you run streaming in CI, instrument the harness to capture 429 counts and latencies. This helps DevEx tune quotas. Add retries with exponential backoff + jitter for non-deterministic tests.

maria.gupta: any naming convention for the GH secret?

kai.huang: we use REDWOOD_HOSTED_API_KEY for prod-like keys and REDWOOD_SANDBOX_KEY for developer sandboxes. For the short-lived tokens from the broker use REDWOOD_TEST_TOKEN. Document which secret is used in the repo README.

maria.gupta: should I prefer self-hosted runners if I request quota bump?

.tom.brennan: yes, if you ask for a hosted test token and quota bump, run on infra-approved self-hosted runners to avoid noisy public runner buckets. Mention that in the support ticket.

maria.gupta: perfect. I'll file the ticket with numbers and attach a small CI snippet. thanks!

kai.huang: ping us on the ticket if you want a quick review of the GH Actions secrets + masking.

maria.gupta: will do, thanks everyone :pray:
